title: At My Husband's Funeral, My Son Asked Who Gets The House. I Handed Him His Father's Envelope.
description:
My husband Harold built our lake house with his own hands. Forty-seven years later, at his funeral, our son asked who gets the house. I handed him the envelope his father left him. He didn't open it. He should have.

Stay until the end. Harold saw all of this coming three years ago, and what he did about it still makes me smile.
